nativeMethod: Native material-specific illustration over fixed v01 geometry. source/refine.py paints surfaces and light directly at 314x206; source/base_native.py reproduces the original shell layers. No large image is read, resized, sharpened or sampled by either renderer.

Milky lamp glass with warm local plaster illumination
